resources.string: Isilawuli esidadayo se-Puzru. Isimo: %1$s. Izilawuli zokuvula okanye ukucima, zokwandisa nezokuvala.

I-Puzru ayifuni akhawunti okanye ukungena ngemvume kwaye ayiceli mvume yemayikrofoni. Ayibambi okanye irekhode iaudio yemayikrofoni, kwaye ayirekhodi okanye igcine iincoko zakho okanye umxholo wazo weaudio.

I-Puzru isebenzisa ulwazi lwesistim yeaudio ye-Android olufunekayo ekuhambiseni iaudio nakuxilongo. Uxilongo lungahlola isimo sobugcisa nemethadatha evezwa zii-API zikawonke-wonke ze-Android, kuquka imethadatha yokudlala neyeseshoni yokurekhoda. Imethadatha yeseshoni yokurekhoda lulwazi lobugcisa lwesistim yeaudio; i-Puzru ayibambi iaudio yemayikrofoni enxulumene nezo seshoni. Ulwazi loxilongo lungabandakanya iinguqulelo zeapp ne-Android, ulwazi lwesixhobo nemodeli, inkqubo nesimo seapp, izixhobo zeaudio ezifumanekayo nezisetyenziswayo, imethadatha kawonke-wonke yokumiselwa kokudlala nokurekhoda, kunye namalinge okuhambisa, iziphumo, ixesha neziganeko zobugcisa.

Iisetingi zeapp zigcinwa kwisigcini sabucala seapp ye-Puzru. Idatha yoxilongo yenziwa ize isetyenzwe kwisixhobo sakho kwaye inokubakho kwisimo sendawo seapp esebenzayo. Iingxelo azigcinwa okanye zithunyelwe ngokuzenzekelayo. Ingxelo esisigxina yenziwa ngaphandle kwesigcini sabucala se-Puzru kuphela xa ukhetha ngokucacileyo Gcina ingxelo yoxilongo uze ukhethe indawo nge-Android. Emva kokuthumela ngaphandle, indawo okanye inkonzo oyikhethileyo—hayi i-Puzru—ilawula ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokucinywa kwaloo kopi.

Inguqulelo yangoku ayiceli mvume ye-Intanethi ye-Android, ayinayo iseva yangasemva ye-Puzru okanye indlela yokuthumela ngenethiwekhi, kwaye ayibandakanyi iinkonzo okanye ii-SDK zohlalutyo, iintengiso okanye iinkonzo zokunika ingxelo xa iapp ima ngokungalindelekanga. Okwangoku ayithumeli iingxelo zoxilongo kumphuhlisi okanye kwiseva ye-Puzru, ngoko i-Puzru ayigcini uxilongo kwiseva.

Idatha yeapp ayifakwa kugcino lwamafu lwe-Android okanye ekudlulisweni phakathi kwezixhobo. Iisetingi zendawo zihlala kwisigcini sabucala seapp de zitshintshwe okanye kususwe idatha yeapp; isimo soxilongo sexeshana asiyongxelo egciniweyo. Iingxelo ezithunyelwe ngaphandle zihlala phantsi kolawulo lwendawo okanye inkonzo oyikhethileyo.
Ukukhetha ulwimi ngaphakathi kwiapp kufuna i-Android 13 okanye entsha. Esi sixhobo silandela ulwimi lwesistim.
Cima isikrini xa ifowuni ikufutshane nendlebe yakho
I-Puzru inceda ukuhambisa iaudio yelizwi exhaswayo kwisamkeli sendlebe esakhelwe ngaphakathi kwifowuni yakho.
Iseshoni yeaudio iphele ngaphambi kokuba ukuhanjiswa kwayo kugqitywe.
Isicelo sokuhambisa iaudio kwisamkeli sendlebe asamkelwanga.
